Name: Verti's Greenhouse
Author: vertibliss
Description:
[center][b][color=#6d9eeb][size=5]Now updated for 1.6!*[/size][/color][/b][/center]
[center][b][size=1]*theoretically. For some reason I never seem to find bugs until people comment on them. Please let me know of any issues![/size][/b][/center]


In a world of a million and one greenhouse interior edits, none of them were quite perfect for my current farm. This inspired me to make my own, which I wasn't fully satisfied with, so I made three more. And now, I'm sharing them! This is my first mod, so if there are any issues of any kind, please let me know. All four versions have about the same crop space, just different layouts and varying tree plots, depending on what you want your focus on. Now includes versions of the original four with pressurized sprinkler compatibility.

[b]Layout Specs:[/b]
[spoiler][i]Default[/i][i] Version
[/i]
[list]
[*]4 10x10 areas, optimized for 4 iridium sprinklers each. You get ~380 plots out of those.[/*]
[*]6 2x24 areas, made with trellis plants in mind. [/*]
[*]14 tree plots.[/*]
[/list]
[i]Version 2[/i]
[list]
[*]The exact same thing as the default version, except the trees have been moved to the front of the greenhouse.[/*]
[/list][i]
Version 3[/i]
[list]
[*]4 10x10 areas.[/*]
[*]4 2x24 areas, made with trellis plants in mind.[/*]
[*]1 2x47 area, also made with trellis plants in mind.[/*]
[*]16 tree plots.[/*]
[/list]
[i]Version 4[/i]
[list]
[*]4 10x10 areas.[/*]
[*]2 4x24 areas.[/*]
[*]2 2x24 areas.[/*]
[*]18 tree plots.[/*]
[/list]
[i]Version 5
[/i]
[list]
[*]4 10x10 areas.[/*]
[*]6 2x24 areas. [/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[b]Pressurized Layout Specs:[/b]
[spoiler][i]Default[/i][i] Version
[/i]
[list]
[*]4 14x14 areas, optimized for 4 pressurized iridium sprinklers each.[/*]
[*]6 2x32 areas, made with trellis plants in mind. [/*]
[*]16 tree plots.[/*]
[/list]
[i]Version 2[/i]
[list]
[*]The exact same thing as the default version, except the trees have been moved to the front of the greenhouse.[/*]
[/list][i]
Version 3[/i]
[list]
[*]4 14x14 areas.[/*]
[*]4 2x32 areas.[/*]
[*]2 2x24 area.[/*]
[*]20 tree plots.[/*]
[/list]
[i]Version 4[/i]
[list]
[*]4 14x14 areas.[/*]
[*]2 4x32 areas.[/*]
[*]2 2x28 areas.[/*]
[*]24 tree plots.[/*]
[/list]
[i]Version 5
[/i]
[list]
[*]4 14x14 areas.[/*]
[*]6 2x32 areas. [/*]
[/list][/spoiler]

[b]How to Install:[/b]
[list]
[*]Make sure you have the latest versions of [b]both[/b] SMAPI and Content Patcher installed[/*]
[*]Empty your greenhouse[/*]
[*]Unzip the downloaded file, and move [CP] Verti's Greenhouse into your Stardew Valley/Mods folder.[/*]
[*]Run the game using SMAPI![/*]
[*][b]To Uninstall:[/b] Just empty your greenhouse and delete the folder :)[/*]
[/list]
[b]How to switch layouts:[/b]
[list]
[*]After running the game using SMAPI once, with the mod installed, there will be a config.json. Open that using a text editor program (i.e. Notepad).[/*]
[*]In the /Samples folder, you will find images of all non-pressurized compatible layouts with the corresponding names for the config file. Switch the greenhouse type to the one you want, and save! Pressurized versions will just have "Pressure" at the end of the config name.[/*]
[*]Alternatively, for a much simpler switch, install [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿[/b] to be able to switch layouts from the title menu.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Bugs:[/b]
[list]
[*]You can currently walk through the bottom wall of the greenhouse into the void. I'm not even remotely sure how to fix this right now.[/*]
[*]You can plant trees anywhere. This bug appears in the vanilla greenhouse as well, so it's not caused by this mod. But you will be able to do it![/*]
[/list]
[b][u]NOTE:[/u]
Make sure your greenhouse is empty before you (un)install this mod. Not doing so runs the risk of shifting crops, making them inaccessible. Don't lose your crops!
[b]I use and highly recommend the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23895]Line Sprinklers 1.6 Redux﻿[/url] mod for all trellis rows. [/b][/b]
